“ Reacher ” sure has some reach. The Prime Video series ended September as the month’s No. 1 original streaming series, according to Nielsen. “Reacher” comes from Paramount TV Studios , which had a good month: The company’s “Reacher” spinoff “ Neagley ” was ranked third, tied with another Paramount TV Studios series, “ Lioness .”
“Reacher” hit the top spot with 4.6 billion minutes viewed, according to Nielsen’s streaming content ratings for viewers 2+ between Sept. 1 and 30, 2026. In second place for the month was Season 4 of Apple TV’s “Ted Lasso,” from Warner Bros. TV, which brought in 3.6 billion minutes of viewing.
Then came “Neagley,” the Paramount TV Studios series that premiered its Season 1 in its entirety on Sept. 16. The Prime Video show received 3.3 billion minutes of viewership during the month — as did Paramount TV Studios’ “Lioness,” which airs on Paramount+.
In fifth place was Netflix’s “Monster: Lizzie Borden,” which premiered Sept. 17 and grabbed 3.1 billion minutes of viewing.
It’s been a solid fall for Paramount TV Studios, as its CBS series “Marshals” premiered Season 2 on Oct. 4 as the week’s No. 1 entertainment series among both broadcast and streaming for the week, according to live+7 multiplatform data.
“Reacher” and “Neagley” both come from Paramount TV Studios and Amazon MGM Studios; Nick Santora is the showrunner on “Reacher” (which stars Alan Ritchson) and serves as co-showrunner with Nicholas Wootton on “Neagley” (which stars Maria Sten). “Lioness” (starring Zoe Saldaña) comes from Paramount TV Studios and 101 Studios; Taylor Sheridan is among the exec producers.
